texts.li: {A_nameDef} wrinkled {A_possessive} nose at the smell from the {THING} across the room.
The {THING} in the corner still smelled of the last carcass, and {A_nameDef} could think of nothing else.
{A_nameDef} looked at the stains on the {THING} and wished someone would move it somewhere else.
[eating] {A_nameDef} ate quickly, with the smell of the {THING} at {A_possessive} back.
[eating] {A_nameDef} pushed the plate away half full. Hard to enjoy a meal next to the {THING}.
[!eating] {A_nameDef} lay down to the smell of old blood from the {THING} in the room.
[morning,!eating] {A_nameDef} woke up to the smell of the {THING} again.
[child] "Why do we sleep next to where the animals get cut up?" {A_nameDef} asked.
Every time someone used the {THING} by {A_nameDef}'s bed, the cold came straight in.
{A_nameDef} stuffed a rolled-up shirt along the bottom of the {THING}. The draught came in anyway.
[morning] {A_nameDef} had felt the cold air from the {THING} across the bed all night.
[morning] {A_nameDef} woke up with cold feet. The draught from the {THING} again.
[evening] {A_nameDef} pulled the blanket up and turned away from the cold coming in at the {THING}.
[morning,snow] Snow had blown in under the {THING} by {A_nameDef}'s bed during the night.
[child,morning] {A_nameDef} had slept with {A_possessive} head under the blanket because of the cold from the {THING}.
